fields.Name: T35 - Data Explorer Search Members
fields.Description: Verifies the Members grid quick-filter is functional.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity grid — type 'Members' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click the EXACT 'Members' match (not 'Board Members'/'Memberships'); if that is giving you trouble, navigate directly to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Members. The grid loads ~100 of ~2,002 records per page. Type a value into the grid's filter box (placeholder 'Filter records...') — e.g. a common first-name fragment — and verify the grid RESPONDS to the filter: the displayed rows narrow to matching ones, OR a clear 'No Matching Rows' state appears if none match on the loaded page. Either response confirms the filter is functional (it is client-side over the loaded page). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Members entity grid is displayed with rows
The grid responded to filter input (rows narrowed to matches, or a clear no-match state was shown)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
